name: Eifu
source:
「I am the woman who will one day become King. I will do anything normal humans can do.」

[url=https://vndb.org/c136820]Kouu[/url]'s army's top musclehead. 

She has a sisterly side, and her subordinates like her, but she has an unhealthy drinking problem. 

Like [url=https://vndb.org/c136825]Ryuuhou[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c136820]Kouu[/url], she aspired to be King, but her dream was destroyed when he saw the Wicked King, [url=https://vndb.org/c136820]Kouu[/url]. 

This creates a problematic alcoholic who, when she drinks excessively, constantly complains that she has learned her limit. 

She has evident strengths and weaknesses. A difficult big sister who cannot be left alone but is a pain in the ass to deal with.
